_meta.purpose: The trading rule set evaluated by forex_mastery.core.rule_engine. Edit this file, not the Python, to change your plan.
_meta.severity_guide: block = the engine returns NO TRADE. warn = the engine returns APPROVED WITH WARNINGS and records why. Missing data on a 'block' rule is treated as a FAILURE (unverified is not approved).

phase_guide.phase_1_chart_reading: Only run the engine with informational rules enabled. You are not trading yet.
phase_guide.phase_2_demo_execution: Tighten to the settings below and never relax them mid-week.
phase_guide.phase_3_live_small: Keep these rules; change limits only at a scheduled monthly review, never during a drawdown.

rules.description: Risk per trade must not exceed 1.00% of equity (0.25% during the first 90 days of demo work).
Planned reward:risk must be at least 1.5:1; anything below relies on a high win rate to survive.
Trade only the majors you have actually studied and backtested.
Trade only in the liquid windows you tested: London, New York, and their overlap.
No new position within 30 minutes before or 15 minutes after a high-impact release; no new positions on major central-bank days.
Skip the trade if the spread is wider than normal for the instrument - a wide spread silently doubles your cost.
Trade only when ATR is inside a normal band: too quiet means no follow-through, too violent means stops are unreliable.
Maximum two trades per day. Overtrading is the most common self-inflicted loss source.
Stop for the day after losing 1% of equity. The day is over; the market will still be there tomorrow.
Stop for the week after losing 3%. A weekly circuit-breaker prevents a bad week becoming a bad account.
After three consecutive losses, stop for 24 hours and re-read the journal before taking the next setup.
At most one position per currency story. Long EURUSD + long GBPUSD + short USDCHF is one USD trade, not three.
Total simultaneous risk must stay at or below 2% while learning.
Counter-trend entries are only allowed when the higher timeframe is explicitly ranging.
Structure must be readable, the level identified, the trigger defined and the invalidation price written down BEFORE entry.
Only setups named in the written trading plan may be taken.
No entry when frustrated, euphoric, bored or revenge-driven; no entry on poor sleep.
The pre-trade checklist must be complete. Incomplete checklists are how 'almost a setup' becomes a loss.
Screenshot before entry, so the review can see what you saw.
